Final honesty pass after T30–T34 land (this ticket depends on all of them). Full context: docs/specs/opencode-integration-continuation.md §T-G.

=== WORK ITEMS ===
1. docs/opencode-integration-plan.md: add a SUPERSEDED banner at top pointing to docs/adr/0004-adlc-opencode-integration.md + docs/specs/opencode-native-flush.md + docs/specs/opencode-integration-continuation.md. It describes never-shipped machinery (signed manifests, admin keys, adlc-runner extensions, pre-commit injection) and asserts in-session bash gating was dropped — contradicted by merged Phase 2 (PR #116). Do not rewrite the body; banner + a short "what actually shipped" delta table.
2. docs/adr/0004-adlc-opencode-integration.md: convert answered open questions to dated decisions — enforce-by-default (Phase 1), the falsified session.prompt outputFormat assumption and its verdict-tool replacement, the anomalyco/opencode repo move, permission.ask status (from T31's probe), keyless bridge live (Phase 4).
3. docs/integrations/opencode.md: final Status/Gaps reconciliation — no capability claimed without a runtime caller; Gaps list reflects what remains after T30–T34 (e.g. TUI module still deferred: PluginModule types tui?: never at 1.17.17, surface reserved not shipped).
4. Mirror the updated status to the docs site page for opencode (apps/docs) if its content diverges.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
AC1: legacy plan doc opens with the superseded banner (verify: head of file).
AC2: ADR 0004 contains the five dated decisions above (verify: read).
AC3: grep for known-false claims returns nothing: "outputFormat" as a session.prompt capability, "proposed SDK extension" for the bridge, unwired-library language for keyless-bridge/gate-bins (verify: targeted grep in docs/).
AC4: docs site opencode page consistent with docs/integrations/opencode.md (verify: diff the overlapping sections).
title: OpenCode docs truth sweep: supersede the legacy plan doc, refresh ADR 0004, final Status/Gaps pass
